o.text: Inherited from Proto-Turkic *čeček (“flower”). Compare Turkish çiçek.
From siç- + -ovul. Cognate with dialectal Turkish sıcavul, sıçoyul, Crimean Tatar sıçavul.
From Classical Persian جلو (jilav). Cognate to Turkmen jylaw.
